monetization.noteEs: Free-to-play con modelo de monetización basado en cosméticos (skins de armas, agents, stickers, gloves) intercambiables vía Steam Marketplace. Las cases requieren keys de $2.50 USD para abrirse y dropean skins de rareza variable. El Prime Status Upgrade (~$15 USD) es opcional y desbloquea matchmaking competitivo, drops semanales y filtros anti-cheat más estrictos. Ningún cosmético afecta gameplay. La economía de skins es masiva: en 2025 generó $1.16 billion USD via cases ($800M) y marketplace fees ($166M). Algunas skins raras valen miles de dólares, lo cual genera economía secundaria de trading especulativo, pero esto es independiente del competitive integrity del juego.
monetization.noteEn: Free-to-play with cosmetics-based monetization model (weapon skins, agents, stickers, gloves) tradeable via Steam Marketplace. Cases require $2.50 USD keys to open and drop skins of variable rarity. Prime Status Upgrade (~$15 USD) is optional and unlocks competitive matchmaking, weekly drops, and stricter anti-cheat filters. No cosmetic affects gameplay. The skin economy is massive: in 2025 it generated $1.16 billion USD via cases ($800M) and marketplace fees ($166M). Some rare skins are worth thousands of dollars, generating a secondary speculative trading economy, but this is independent of the game's competitive integrity.
